name: Chitwan
description: Terai district in Bagmati Province containing Chitwan National Park.

_comparable_period.note: Provisional overlap of NRT snapshot windows; final harmonization period requires standard-processing availability.

limitations: Near real-time (NRT) 7-day global snapshot; not standard processing (SP).
No ground truth; counts are satellite detections, not burned area.
Missing observations are marked unavailable/missing, never zero-filled.
Sensors are reported separately; MODIS and VIIRS are never combined.
citations: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), NASA LANCE/EOSDIS.
